skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic issues related to customs administration, state management of customs, and organization of customs activities.
Apply basic knowledge about customs operations, valuation rules, and tax regulations to specific situations.
Analyze factors influencing customs decisions and apply knowledge to practical problems.
Perform customs operations such as determining origin, protecting intellectual property rights, and calculating customs duties.
Apply knowledge in state management of customs, customs procedures, and tax operations to real-world scenarios.
Develop independent work skills, teamwork abilities, and effective communication in group settings.
Demonstrate self-directed learning, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills in practical contexts.
Understand and apply tax procedures, including declaration, payment, and determination of taxes.
Protect intellectual property rights within customs agencies.
Understand international customs cooperation and organizational structures of global customs organizations.
